fact: Communications and ICT Minister Angellah Kairuki said on 18 July 2026 that Tanzania is building a National AI Data Centre, to hold the country's data onshore so Tanzanian and African researchers can train AI systems on it using hydro and geothermal power.
system: Kituo cha Taifa cha Data za Akili Unde (National AI Data Centre)

fact: The UDSM DHIS2 Lab implemented the AI-based alert triage tool now used by Tanzania's Ministry of Health in its event-based surveillance; the document says it uses a rule-based approach with human interaction, with machine learning planned.
The e-Government Authority says Msaada AI, Muhtasari AI and Tafsiri AI were designed at its e-Government Research, Innovation and Development Centre, and Msaada AI is in use by two institutions.

Muhimbili University researchers built a chest X-ray AI for TB in people with HIV, trained on about 3,000 patient images from public facilities, reporting 92% accuracy, and it is now in trials ahead of TMDA approval.
HostAfrica, having completed its acquisition of Zesha, says it is rolling out Nvidia Blackwell GPUs in Tanzania, which it claims are the first of their kind available on the continent.

Ghent University's IDLab-AIRO says it installed a new GPU workstation at Mzumbe University in Morogoro, from which a workshop served LLMs, image generation and speech pipelines, as the university's new Centre for AI Research and Innovation (CAIRI) was inaugurated.
